info.title: Furnace inference server
info.description: HTTP API of the Furnace inference server. Prose reference with examples: docs/API.md.

200.description: The server is up and its model is loaded
The server is up and its model is loaded

get.description: 200 once the warm-up inference has run, 503 before. /healthz says the process is alive; this says it is ready for traffic.

200.description: Request, error, batching and latency counters since startup

get.description: JSON by default. A request whose Accept header lists text/plain or application/openmetrics-text before any JSON type (as Prometheus sends) gets the Prometheus text exposition format instead.

200.description: Input and output shapes, backend and inference statistics

get.summary: Description and statistics of a named model

200.description: As GET /model/info, for the model named in the path

post.summary: Run inference on a named model
post.description: As `POST /predict`, for the model named in the path.

parameters.name: Accept
parameters.description: `application/octet-stream` returns the outputs as raw little-endian float32 instead of JSON

schema.description: batch x input size little-endian float32 values

X-Output-Shape.description: Per-item output shape of a binary response, comma separated

X-Inference-Time-Ms.description: Inference time of a binary response

post.description: Enabled by `--admin-token`; send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Loads the model again (from `weights` when given, else from where it was loaded), runs a warm-up inference, then switches to it. Requests already running finish on the previous model; if anything fails, the previous model keeps serving.

404.description: The admin API is off, or no such model

post.description: Each item is the model input flattened in row-major order (ResNet-18: 3 x 224 x 224 = 150,528 floats, CHW, ImageNet-normalized). Send JSON, raw little-endian float32 (`application/octet-stream`, with `X-Batch-Size` for a batch), or, in a build with the `image` feature, one JPEG or PNG image. Outputs are raw logits.

post.description: One FP32 input named `input`, shape [batch, ...item shape] (or the item shape alone). `data` may be flat or nested. With the binary tensor data extension, the JSON is followed by raw little-endian bytes: set the Inference-Header-Content-Length header to the JSON's length and `binary_data_size` on the input; ask for binary outputs with `binary_data` on a requested output or `binary_data_output` on the request.

parameters.name: Inference-Header-Content-Length
parameters.description: Binary tensor data: length of the JSON part of the body

schema.description: JSON header followed by raw tensor bytes

200.description: Outputs; with binary outputs, the JSON header (length in Inference-Header-Content-Length) followed by raw bytes

Inference-Header-Content-Length.description: Binary outputs: length of the JSON header

get.description: Every neuron (kind, mechanisms, what it is), every pathway (kind, weight, measured p50/p99 latency) and the fabric's counters. The served models appear as `in:{model}` → `model:{model}` → `serve:respond`.
Server-sent events, one per command the named SSE effector acts on. See docs/NERVE.md.

200.description: The effector's commands as they happen

404.description: No SSE effector of that name

post.description: OpenAI's chat completions: messages in, the assistant's reply out, streamed or at once. Served when the server has an LLM. See docs/LLM.md.

200.description: The completion as JSON, or with "stream": true server-sent events ending with [DONE]

post.description: OpenAI's legacy completions: one prompt in, its continuation out. Served when the server has an LLM. See docs/LLM.md.

200.description: The completion as JSON, or with "stream": true server-sent events ending with [DONE]

get.description: The LLMs, then the server's other models, in OpenAI's list shape.

BatchSize.name: X-Batch-Size
BatchSize.description: Binary requests: the body holds this many items and the JSON response uses `outputs`

RequestId.name: X-Request-Id
RequestId.description: ID for this request, 1-128 visible ASCII characters; generated when absent
The request's ID: the client's X-Request-Id, or a generated UUID

Error.description: Error; see `code`. 400 invalid input, 404 MODEL_NOT_FOUND, 413 body too large, 415 unsupported content type, 422 malformed request, 500 INFERENCE_FAILED or INTERNAL_ERROR, 503 SERVER_BUSY, 504 INFERENCE_TIMEOUT

Unauthorized.description: API keys are required and none or an unknown one was sent (`UNAUTHORIZED`)

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the client may retry

PredictResponse.description: `output` for a single input, `outputs` for a batch

total_requests.description: Inference requests received, including ones rejected before inference

total_errors.description: Inference requests answered with a 4xx or 5xx status

rejected_unauthorized.description: Requests rejected with 401 for a missing or unknown API key

rejected_rate_limited.description: Requests rejected with 429 by the rate limit

in_flight_inferences.description: Requests queued for or running inference

request_latency_ms.description: Inference request latency from arrival to response, in milliseconds

inference_latency_ms.description: Successful inference latency, queueing included, in milliseconds

ready.description: Whether every model's warm-up inference has run

models.description: Per model; the totals above are over all of them

nerve.description: The nervous system, as GET /nerve describes it: the served models' pathways and the neurons added with Server::nerve

llm.description: The LLMs (feature llm), with their own counters; absent without any. See docs/LLM.md.

input_spec.description: The first input; open dimensions are 0. See `inputs` for models with several

inputs.description: Every input, by the name POST /v2/models/{model}/infer takes. A simple model (one FP32 tensor in, one out) has one named `input`

shape.description: Per item, without the batch dimension

code.description: Machine-readable error, the same on /predict and v2 (see the errors table in docs/API.md). INVALID_IMAGE needs the image feature.

Percentiles.description: Estimated from a histogram; null before the first observation

shape.description: -1 for the batch dimension and for dimensions fixed per request

name.description: `input` for a simple model; otherwise the model's input names (GET /v2/models/{model})

datatype.description: INT32 is taken for INT64 inputs

data.description: Values in row-major order, flat or nested
Values in row-major order; integers for INT64

ready.description: Whether its warm-up inference has run

reloadable.description: Whether the admin API can reload it

weights.description: New weight file (a .bpk for a built-in model, a model path for a file-based one); by default the model reloads from where it was loaded
The weight file given in the request

inference_latency_ms.description: Successful inference latency, queueing included, in milliseconds

shape.description: Full shape: -1 for the batch dimension and for dimensions fixed per request

apiKey.description: One of the `--api-key` values; `X-API-Key: <key>` works too. Only required when the server has API keys
